localReader.observation: The graph trace reports 40 nodes, 314 edges, 40 staged handles, 479 source records and 456 XRECORD payload slots, then refuses at XRECORD 0x2BCF code 330 target 0x1BE5 (decimal 7141). XRECORD 0x2BCF has owner/reactor 0x2BCE and 208 ordered handle values. The model space has 2,777 entities. The earlier probe's apparent omission was a probe bug: it scanned only data.blocks and skipped mBlock. The NOD-owned dictionary 0x2BCE contains ASEBlockHierarchyIndexRecord -> 0x2BCF.
